intent.direct: Send a direct instruction, not a quote or forwarded message.
intent.question: This is a question; no PAPER proposal was created.
intent.conditional: Conditional instructions are unsupported and are not queued.
intent.rejected_pending: Pending PAPER proposals rejected; send a new buy request separately.
intent.live: LIVE requires the exact /spot live-buy SYMBOL AMOUNT command; it is not converted to PAPER.
intent.live_balance: Live Binance balance is not queried by RiskPilot. Use Binance directly for account balances; RiskPilot exposes only protected trade readiness.
intent.close_symbol: Specify exactly one symbol to close.
intent.deferred: The buy is not queued; request it again after the close completes.
intent.percentage_range: Close percentage must be greater than 0 and at most 100%.
intent.close_quote: Specify a valid USD close value.
intent.close_positive: Close value must be greater than 0.
intent.selector: Specify all, a percentage, coin quantity, or USD close value.
intent.buy_fields: Specify exactly one symbol and one USDT amount.
intent.buy_positive: PAPER BUY amount must be greater than 0 USDT.
intent.approval: Approval requires a PAPER button or a one-time code.
intent.clarify: Do you mean PAPER buy, close, positions, or balance?
analysis.reason.pending_symbol: A pending or processing PAPER BUY already exists for {symbol}.
analysis.reason.exposure: Projected PAPER exposure would exceed {limit} USDT.
analysis.reason.bullish_gate: The existing scheduled bullish eligibility gate did not pass.
analysis.reason.pending_limit: The maximum active proposal count has been reached.
analysis.reason.aggregate_risk: The PAPER aggregate open-risk limit is exhausted.
analysis.reason.daily_loss: The PAPER daily realized-loss cap is exhausted.
analysis.reason.confirmation: Agent OS confirmation did not match.
analysis.conclusion.up: Conditional conclusion: only if a later closed 15m candle holds above local resistance would this UP snapshot support a breakout observation; it is not an entry instruction.
analysis.conclusion.down: Conditional conclusion: only if a later closed 15m candle reclaims local support would this DOWN snapshot weaken; it is not an entry instruction.
analysis.conclusion.flat: Conditional conclusion: only if a later closed 15m candle breaks outside the local support/resistance range would this FLAT snapshot change; it is not an entry instruction.
analysis.scenario.up: Conditional scenario for {symbol}: a later closed 15m candle above {resistance} USDT could be a breakout observation; a pullback that holds near {support} USDT would be a separate observation. Two 15m candles are only a short-term snapshot. No proposal created.
analysis.scenario.down: Conditional scenario for {symbol}: a later closed 15m candle reclaiming {support} USDT could soften the downside snapshot; rejection near {resistance} USDT would be a separate observation. Two 15m candles are only a short-term snapshot. No proposal created.
analysis.scenario.flat: Conditional scenario for {symbol}: a later closed 15m candle above {resistance} USDT or below {support} USDT could resolve this range snapshot. Two 15m candles are only a short-term snapshot. No proposal created.
error.unavailable: RiskPilot could not complete the request. No unverified result is presented.
error.security: Request refused: authorization or safety validation failed.
approval.expired: Approval expired or is no longer pending. No new execution was performed.
approval.replay: This PAPER action was already handled or cannot be repeated. No new execution was performed.
policy.min_order: Request refused: the amount is below the minimum after exchange rounding. The amount was not increased.
policy.max_order_exceeded: Requested amount {amount} USDT exceeds the configured maximum of {maximum} USDT.
policy.non_positive: Requested amount must be greater than 0 USDT.
policy.risk_limit: Request refused: a risk, exposure, quota, balance, or exchange limit was reached.
